top_signals.title: Mozambique, Senegal Eurobonds Top Emerging Market Returns, Lifted by IMF Talks
top_signals.summary: Mozambique and Senegal’s eurobonds are topping returns across emerging markets, spurred by progress in talks with the International Monetary Fund over new programs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Trump photo seems to reference Kennedy Center demolition amid legal battle over closure
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump wants his name on the Kennedy Center. But a judge has ruled it cannot be placed there without authorization by Congress.
